final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS all_patient_avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic, AVG(p.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.avg_ratio - o.all_patient_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.all_patient_avg_ratio
